Based on my search, here is how to log into OneDrive:

## How to Log Into OneDrive

### Method 1: Via Web Browser
1. Open your web browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, etc.)
2. Go to **https://onedrive.com/sign-in** or **https://onedrive.live.com**
3. Enter your **Microsoft account email address or phone number**
4. Click **"Next"**
5. Enter your **password**
6. Click **"Sign in"**

### Method 2: On Windows PC (Desktop App)
1. Click the **Start Menu** and search for **"OneDrive"**
2. Click on the **OneDrive app** to open it
3. Enter your **Microsoft account email** when prompted
4. Enter your **password**
5. Follow any additional setup prompts

### Method 3: On Mobile Devices (iPhone/Android)
1. Download the **OneDrive app** from the App Store or Google Play Store
2. Open the app
3. Tap **"Sign in"**
4. Enter your **Microsoft account email and password**

---

## Important Notes

- **Your Microsoft account is your OneDrive account** — they use the same login credentials
- If you don't have a Microsoft account, you can create one for free at https://signup.live.com
- If you have **two-factor authentication** enabled, you'll need to complete the additional verification step

---

## Troubleshooting Login Issues

If you can't log in, try these solutions:

| Problem | Solution |
|---------|----------|
| Forgot password | Click **"Forgot password"** on the sign-in page to reset it |
| Error 0x8004de85/0x8004de8a | Check that you're using the correct account type (personal vs. work/school) |
| Error 0x8004de40 | Enable TLS 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2 in Internet Options (run `inetcpl.cpl`) |
| App won't sign in | Try unlinking and relinking: Right-click OneDrive icon → Settings → Account → Unlink this PC → Sign in again |
| OneDrive stuck spinning | Reset OneDrive: Exit OneDrive, run `%localappdata%\Microsoft\OneDrive\onedrive.exe /reset` in Command Prompt |

Sources:
1. https://one-drive.helpshift.com/hc/faq/10-how-to-sign-in-to-onedrive-account/
2. https://www.xda-developers.com/how-to-sign-into-onedrive/
3. https://www.cu.edu/doc/how-log-onedrive-pcpdf-3
4. https://zhidao.baidu.com/question/2000987832475803467.html
5. https://strand-co.com/guide-sign-in-onedrive-download/
6. https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/sharepoint/troubleshoot/sync/sign-into-onedrive-error-0x8004de85-or-0x8004de8a
7. https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/sharepoint/troubleshoot/sync/error-0x8004de40-in-onedrive
8. https://www.feidaoboke.com/post/fix-onedrive-login-issue-error-code-0x8004de44.html
9. https://www.elevenforum.com/t/onedrive-suddenly-wont-log-in-and-sync.28940/
10. https://consumer.huawei.com/cn/support/content/zh-cn00954695/
